maxLogFiles.description: Define the maximum number of logs files to retain

connectionName.description: Name of the connectivity definition, used when referenced from actions

actions.description: The unique identifier for a product

ID.description: Identifier of the action displayed in the log

enabled.description: Execute the action when running the configuration

object.description: System name of the Omada data object type the action is applied to, for example 'Identity' or 'Resource'

connectionName.description: Select connectivity configuration by specifying the name of the config

sourcefile.description: CSV file of the data to be processed by the loader

sourceDelimiter.description: Delimiter used in the CSV file, for example , or ;

sourceOmadaOdataObject.description: Query Omada via OData for objects of the type defined here (use the DOT system name) as the source of the action

sourceOmadaOdataParams.description: Parameters for OData query to select properties and filtering, example: "?$filter=?ISLOGICALSYSTEM eq true&$top=10"

sourceOmadaOdataParamsScript.description: Script that define the parameters for OData query to select properties and filtering, $page contain the page number. Example: return '?&$orderby=Id&$top=4&$skip=' + $page*4

sourceSQLQueryNextPageScript.description:
Script to define the SQL select statement for next page. 
Variables: 
	   $page is page number starting at 2
    $lastIdentifier is the value from the previous page defined by the config parameter sourceLastIdentifierColumn

sourceSQLQueryNextPageScriptFile.description:
Script file to define the SQL select statement for next page. 
Variables: 
	   $page is page number starting at 2
    $lastIdentifier is the value from the previous page defined by the config parameter sourceLastIdentifierColumn

sourceLastIdentifierColumn.description: For use with pagination the variable $lastIdentifier is populated with the value from the last record in the previous page with the column name specified

targetSystemName.description: Name of target system, can be partial like in the prov. jobs UI search columns

identityName.description: Name of identity system, can be partial like in the prov. jobs UI search columns

batchSize.description: Max. number of jobs to read in each call

targetSystemName.description: Name of target system, can be partial like in the claims UI search columns

accountName.description: Account name, can be partial like in the claims UI search columns

identityName.description: Identity display name, can be partial like in the claims UI search columns

resource.description: Resource name, can be partial like in the claims UI search columns

batchSize.description: Max. number of claims to read in each call

sourceMaxPages.description: Maximum number of query executions when using SQL, OData or Omada Query as the source

operation.description: Operation to perform on the targeted data object in Omada

sourceIdentifier.description: Name of the value column in the source used as key and to aggregate multiple records in the source into one object

sourceIdentifierScript.description: Script to resolve the identifier of a record, data is available in the $record variable

sourceDisplayName.description: Optional value column for displaying in the log

targetIdentifier.description: System name of the Data Object property used to lookup the object in Omada. For advanced queries use the parameter targetObjectQuery

targetObjectQuery.description: Query string used to lookup the object in Omada with OData. Values from the record can be inserted by specifying the column name in curly brackets {}. Example: "ROLEID eq '{u_resid}'"

maxObjects.description: Define the maximum number of objects to process (for testing). Zero mean process all

batchSize.description: Batch size for FastBatchCreate operation, should be 20-50 in most cases.

maxConcurrentJobs.description: The maximum number of concurrent processes is defined by this setting. For most cases the value should be 3-10 as too many parallel processes will have a negative impact on performance or even lead to errors.

startIndex.description:
Define the first record in the source to process (skipping the prior ones),
Important: the first record have index 0

progressTracking.description: Enables progress tracking to allow rerun of the action without processing already processed objects

sleep.description: Number of milliseconds to wait between processing of each record, default 0

script.description: powershell script return $true to filter record out, record values are available in the variable $record

excludelistFile.description: CSV file (UTF8 encoded) of records (by ID) to exclude

fileIdentifierCol.description: Column in CSV file containing the list of IDs to exclude

recordProperty.description: Property on the source record used as ID

delimiter.description: Delimiter used in the CSV file, for example , or ;

ignoreCase.description:
When enable the matching values are compared ignoring case
(example: 'id17' is matching 'ID17')

sourceDelimiter.description: Delimiter used in the CSV file, for example , or ;

lookupProperty.description: The property in the record to search for in the csv file

lookupColumn.description: The column in the the CSV file to search in

valueColumn.description: The column in the csv to set in the record

valueProperty.description: The property in the record to receive the value

ignoreCase.description:
When enable the matching values are compared ignoring case
(example: 'id17' is matching 'ID17')

queryDOT.description: System name of the data object type to search for

queryFilter.description: OData style filter to search for the object. Properties from the source record can be inserted in curly brackets

queryProperty.description: Property system name on the Omada Data Object to search for

SkipNotFound.description: When enabled the record processing continues even when no result is returned for the lookup, otherwise processing of the object fails

logNoMatch.description: Log when no match is found

script.description: Script returning a value, the values are available in the $record variable

map.description: Defines the mapping from the source record to the target Omada data object

sourceProperty.description: The name of the property from source data or defined in preprocessing that contain the value to be set

sourceScript.description: Script that return the value to be set. Source data is available in the variable $record

defaultValue.description: Default value used if the value of sourceProperty is empty

inputdateformat.description: Define the format of the date in the source data, example yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:sszzz

targetProperty.description: System name of the Omada property to receive the value

KeyProperty.description: When assigning values to reference properties this define the property name of the referenced object

deltaOp.description: Define delta operation (Add/Remove) for reference properties

deltaOpScript.description: Script to define the delta oparation (Add or Remove) - the values of the record being processed are available in $record
